baseline_models.mechanism: Parties taking different routes cannot make route-possession itself the final criterion; the disputed object is transferred to one adjudicative authority.

activation_trace.role: The literal image is each party taking a route unlike the other's; it supplies the divergence that requires a common forum.
The literal branch is judgment between people; it supplies the shared adjudicative function.

changed_reading.after: Divergent routes do not authorize their own final norms; the disputed thing is referred to a single adjudicative authority.

baseline_models.mechanism: Judgment restrains damaging motion for repair, the Lord nurtures toward completion, and entrustment releases the speaker's claim to self-authorize the remedy.

activation_trace.role: The literal branch is prevention and repulsion for rectification; it makes judgment a corrective restraint rather than a bare pronouncement.
The literal branch is repairing, nurturing, and completing; it gives the invoked Lord a restorative function.
The literal branch is handing an affair to another; it transfers remedial control away from the disputant.

changed_reading.before: The verse names the owner of the verdict.
changed_reading.after: The verse submits disagreement to a restraining, repairing governance and makes relinquished self-authorization part of the remedy.

baseline_models.mechanism: Reliance and recurrent directional return convert referral from a one-time proposition into a repeatable posture whenever disagreement recurs.

activation_trace.role: The literal branch is reliance on another; it supplies the stable posture during unresolved difference.
The literal branch is customary return, time after time; it makes recourse iterative.
The split-root branch is repeated return toward a place or direction; it sharpens the repeated movement as God-directed.

changed_reading.before: The speaker accepts one ruling once.
changed_reading.after: Each recurrence of dispute calls for renewed entrustment and repeated reorientation toward God.

baseline_models.mechanism: The general object that can be known and reported makes the referral principle domain-wide rather than confined to a favored class of disputes.

activation_trace.role: The literal branch is an object knowable and reportable; under the focus construction it supplies the unrestricted dispute-object.
The literal branch is referral to an appointed arbiter; it carries every such object into the same jurisdiction.

changed_reading.before: Only specially religious controversies are in view.
changed_reading.after: No class of knowable, reportable dispute-object is self-exempt from referral.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding counterfactual says God could have produced one community but did not; referral therefore governs real plurality without making coerced sameness the verse's first remedy.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch pictures parties on unlike routes; it anchors the retained plurality in ٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ.
The focus branch supplies adjudication between people as the response to those unlike routes.
The literal branch is will directed toward an object; both occurrences make communal configuration dependent on divine willing.
The literal branch is making something assume a state; it supplies the unrealized possibility of making the people one community.
The literal branch is uniting things in one direction; it defines the uniformity God could have imposed.

structural_cues: 42:8 places the unrealized one-community counterfactual immediately before 42:9-10.
42:10 responds to existing difference with referral, not with a command to manufacture uniformity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine capacity for one communal state, its non-realization, and subsequent dispute-referral; I infer that adjudication manages permitted plurality rather than first erasing it. A live alternative is that 42:8 explains moral sorting and grants no positive value to disagreement.

changed_reading.before: Divine judgment primarily means eliminating difference by imposing sameness.
changed_reading.after: Divine judgment supplies a common criterion for plurality that God could have prevented but allows to remain real.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated thing-language expands the dispute domain while the following negated likeness excludes God from thing-to-thing comparison; hearing and seeing support adjudicative access without making the judge one comparable claimant.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch is the knowable, reportable object; it defines the broad field over which disagreement ranges.
The focus branch is judgment between people; it anchors the judge-function being qualified.
The literal branch is likeness and counterpart; its negation blocks assimilating God to any party or object.
The same literal thing-branch now occurs inside the incomparability clause; it draws a boundary around the focus's universal object-domain.
The literal branch is auditory apprehension; it supplies receptive access to claims without comparison to claimants.
The literal branch is visual apprehension; it supplies inspection of the disputed field.

structural_cues: 42:11 follows the focus immediately and repeats شَىْءٌ after the focus's مِن شَىْءٍ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal thing-language, negated likeness, hearing, and seeing; I infer a categorical asymmetry between disputed objects and their judge. A live alternative is that 42:11 is solely a creedal assertion with no procedural force for 42:10.

changed_reading.before: God resolves disputes as the strongest member within the same comparison field.
changed_reading.after: All comparable things may be disputed, but the adjudicator is not another comparable thing and does not depend on claimant-sized access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence diagnoses one form of fragmentation as arising after disclosed knowledge through mutual overreach, then answers it with commanded equity; divine judgment therefore tests the ethics that generate and conduct a dispute.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch is route-divergence and contention; it anchors the diagnosed disagreement.
The focus branch is restraint for rectification; it makes diagnosis and correction part of judgment.
The literal branch is scattering into parts; it supplies the social disintegration under examination.
The literal branch is disclosure to a knower; its prior arrival rules out simple ignorance as the only cause.
The literal branch is transgressive overstepping; it supplies the stated social cause of this fragmentation.
The literal branch is justice in judgment and conduct; it supplies the required counter-practice.

structural_cues: 42:13 forbids fragmentation, 42:14 names knowledge followed by mutual transgression, and 42:15 commands justice between the parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence fragmentation-after-knowledge, transgression-between-them, then equity; I treat that sequence as a causal diagnosis and remedy for a class of focus disputes. A live alternative is that the diagnosis is historical and should not be generalized to every disagreement.

changed_reading.before: Disagreement is only a neutral shortage of information.
changed_reading.after: Some disagreement is knowledge-corrupted power behavior, so referral to God includes exposing excess and requiring equity from the disputants.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ultimate judgment and proximate procedure occupy different levels: affairs remain under divine norm while the responsive community extracts judgment through reciprocal consultation rather than abandoning its agency.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch is referral and authorization of an arbiter; it anchors ultimate jurisdiction.
The literal branch is mutual passing-off that loses an affair; used contrastively, it prevents trust from becoming communal abdication.
The literal branch is consultation and management of opinion; it identifies the human affair as a field of deliberative responsibility.
The literal branch is extracting an opinion by mutual review; it supplies the proximate decision process.

structural_cues: 42:38 states أَمْرُهُمْ شُورَىٰ بَيْنَهُمْ inside a description of those responding to their Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ultimate referral in 42:10 and consultation among the community in 42:38; I distinguish divine norm from human procedure so both clauses remain operative. A live alternative is that consultation applies only where no revealed judgment bears on the dispute.

changed_reading.before: Referring judgment to God means bypassing human deliberation.
changed_reading.after: Ultimate norm belongs to God while proximate communal affairs still require reciprocal, responsible consultation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine referral sets a ceiling of equivalence, recognizes victim redress, and opens a higher restorative path through relinquishing punishment, repairing relation, self-restraint, and protective covering.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch is restraint for rectification; it anchors both the ceiling and the restorative purpose.
The focus branch is nurturing repair and completion; it supports an outcome beyond reciprocal injury.
The literal branch is equivalence and counterpart; it caps response at like-for-like.
The literal branch is leaving punishment and erasing offense; it opens the non-retaliatory exit.
The literal branch is removing estrangement by reconciliation; it gives pardon a reparative direction.
The literal branch is a wronged person's obtaining redress; it prevents restorative judgment from erasing the victim's standing.
The literal branch is restraining the self from reactive anguish; it supplies the internal brake.
The literal branch is covering an offense and shielding its bearer from its effect; it supplies the protective end of forgiveness.

structural_cues: 42:39-43 moves from vindication, through equivalent response and no blame, to pardon, repair, patience, and forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proportionality, legitimate redress, pardon, repair, patience, and forgiveness; I infer that focus judgment coordinates them as a bounded process with a restorative off-ramp. A live alternative is that these verses give adjacent ethics without defining the mechanism of 42:10.

changed_reading.before: Referral to God requires either passive surrender or immediate punishment.
changed_reading.after: Referral bounds self-defense, preserves the wronged party's standing, and directs exercised restraint toward repair rather than escalation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Lord's corrective judgment resembles calibrated provision: expansion and constriction are measured because unbounded abundance can produce overreach, so restraint may serve cultivation rather than deprivation.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch is prevention for rectification; it anchors measured restraint as judgment.
The focus branch is gradual nurture toward completion; it makes restraint serve development.
The literal branch is spreading and extension against contraction; it supplies the expansion side of calibration.
The literal branch is apportioned giving; it makes the expanded or restricted material an allocation.
The literal branch is narrowing a thing to a limited measure; it supplies corrective constriction.
The literal branch is overstepping the limit; it states the risk produced by unbounded expansion.
The literal branch is managing an affair by measure and consideration; it supplies the regulating response to that risk.

structural_cues: 42:12 pairs expanded provision with constriction; 42:27 explains that unrestricted expansion would produce transgression and instead names measured descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calibrated provision and explicitly links unlimited expansion to overreach; I analogize that regulatory pattern to the focus's corrective judgment under the nurturing Lord. A live alternative is that resource governance should not be extended to interpersonal or doctrinal disputes.

changed_reading.before: Divine judgment is only a verbal ruling delivered after conflict.
changed_reading.after: Divine judgment can also be preventive calibration that limits excess so persons and relations can be repaired and matured.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same reliance field reverses roles: the speaker entrusts himself to God but is not appointed as others' sufficient guardian; later, guarding is again denied and the remit is delivery.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch is reliance on another; it anchors the speaker's own dependence rather than control over others.
The focus branch is transfer of judgment to an arbiter; it anchors the jurisdictional transfer that limits the speaker's role.
The literal branch is an agent sufficient to preserve and manage an affair; its negation denies that custodial office to the addressee.
The literal branch is guarding and watching over something; its negation repeats the limit on coercive custody.
The literal branch is conveying a message to its destination; it supplies the positive, bounded remit left after guardianship is denied.

structural_cues: 42:6 says the addressee is not a wakil over them; 42:48 repeats that he is not a keeper and limits his duty to delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies personal reliance, denied custodial agency, and a delivery-only remit; I infer that God's judgment cannot be used to inflate the speaker into coercive ownership of disputants. A live alternative is that these role limits are messenger-specific and do not govern every later human adjudicator.

changed_reading.before: Claiming that judgment belongs to God authorizes the claimant to control those who disagree.
changed_reading.after: The confession removes coercive custodianship from the speaker: trust is personal dependence, delivery is bounded, and final guarding and judgment remain God's.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's closing communication protocol separates where judgment belongs from how humans receive guidance: hidden imparting, a veil, or a messenger mediates access, and revelation illuminates a path rather than making private confidence infallible.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch is referral of judgment to an arbiter; it anchors the destination whose human accessibility is being qualified.
The focus branch is repeated directional return; it supplies a humble orientation rather than possession of the destination.
The literal branch is divine report and inspiration; it supplies one authorized mode by which guidance crosses the gap.
The literal branch is a screening barrier; it makes mediated distance explicit.
The literal branch is messenger and message; it supplies commissioned mediation rather than private seizure of judgment.
The literal branch is illumination; it presents revelation as what makes a way perceptible.
The literal branch is gentle direction to a road or truth; it supplies guided movement rather than unmediated ownership.

structural_cues: 42:51 enumerates constrained modes of divine communication; 42:52 then describes the communicated spirit as light and guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ultimate referral and a restricted, mediated account of divine-human communication; I distinguish judgment's divine destination from a disputant's mode of access to it. A live alternative is that 42:51-52 concerns prophetic revelation only and does not directly regulate ordinary claims about disputes.

changed_reading.before: Because judgment belongs to God, a sincere disputant can treat private certainty as direct possession of God's ruling.
changed_reading.after: Judgment's divine ownership intensifies epistemic humility: access is mediated and illuminating, so trust and return cannot be converted into private infallibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker's repeated return is nested inside a surah-wide directional movement: return is met by guidance, and every affair eventually becomes toward God, making adjudication iterative and teleological rather than necessarily immediate.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch is repeated return toward a direction; it anchors the speaker's personal movement.
The focus branch is adjudication between people; it anchors the disputed affair whose timing is being revised.
The same literal branch of repeated directional return occurs with divine guidance; it links return to being guided.
The literal branch is becoming toward an outcome; it supplies the terminal movement to God.
The literal branch is affair or state; it expands the terminal movement from this dispute to all affairs.

structural_cues: The directional إِلَيْهِ of 42:10 recurs with the returning person in 42:13 and the outcome of all affairs in 42:53.
42:53 closes the surah by universalizing the focus's movement toward God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated return, guidance of the returning person, and all affairs becoming toward God; I infer a temporal arc in which faithful referral can precede visible resolution. A live alternative is that the repeated directional language is rhetorical and says nothing about delayed adjudication.

changed_reading.before: Referral promises an immediately available answer to every dispute.
changed_reading.after: Referral establishes repeated orientation while disputed affairs move toward an eventual divine outcome, whether or not resolution is immediate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the equine material branch of ح ك م rather than the ordinary legal branch. It remains anchored directly in حُكْمُ and gains coherence from the focus's divergent routes; downstream prose should mark it as a controlling analogy, never as a replacement translation.

activation_trace.role: The literal branch is parties taking different routes; it supplies motion liable to run apart.
The literal branch is the bridle around an animal's jaws that checks its run; it casts judgment as steering divergent motion.

changed_reading.before: Judgment is only a proposition announced after divergence.
changed_reading.after: Judgment can be pictured as a bridle that checks divergent movement so it can be redirected without running away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the passage-from-constriction branch is distant from the normal sense of ٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ. It remains anchored in the same focus root and is sharpened by the surah's closing straight-road recurrence; downstream prose should call it a spatial activation, not lexical exegesis.

activation_trace.role: The literal branch is a passage leading from constriction into openness; it recasts disagreement as terrain requiring a viable exit.
The literal branch is repeated directional return; it supplies continual rerouting toward the exit.
The literal branch is the straight road; it supplies the closing spatial destination of guidance.
The repeated literal straight-road branch identifies that road with God and stabilizes the spatial activation.

changed_reading.before: Divine judgment merely terminates an argument.
changed_reading.after: Referral can be spatially imagined as repeatedly routing divergent parties through constriction toward a shared road and wider passage.

strongest_changes: The one-community counterfactual recasts adjudication as governance of real plurality rather than forced sameness.
Consultation among the community separates ultimate divine norm from proximate human deliberation.
Measured provision and bounded retaliation make judgment restraining and restorative, not verdict-only.
Denied guardianship and mediated revelation block coercive or privately infallible possession of divine judgment.
Repeated return and the outcome of all affairs introduce iterative and teleological time.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet joined the immediate plurality and incomparability frame to distant consultation, proportional justice, role limits, and mediated guidance; together they changed a short jurisdictional statement into a disciplined ecology of difference, access, restraint, and return.
remaining_uncertainties: The boundary between matters settled by disclosed judgment and matters left to consultation remains unspecified.
The measured-provision mechanism is a coherent cross-domain analogy, but its extension to every dispute remains exploratory.
The split ن و ب inventories support recurrent directional return with different lexical distances.
The bridle and narrow-passage outliers are branch-anchored images, not candidate replacement translations.
